releaseNotes: 1,000 additional plant-based dinners: 300 vegan and 700 vegetarian, taking the dinner catalogue to 3,000.
Gather ingredients using a shared checklist before cooking and in the guided preparation step; ticks persist when you pause and clear when you finish or cancel.
Short, relevant cooking stage headings and a consistent keep-awake switch at the top of preparation and cooking guides.
Tidier ingredient rows and expandable cupboard meal usage, with less unnecessary cooking and preparation text.
Improved food filters, provider allergen coverage, pack pricing and ingredient matching, with verified source photos.
The matching installable web app for iPhone and iPad includes the same QA25 changes.
